entries.text: 这一次命中要害，\n是我绝对不想输的意志带来的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_01
entries.text: 我一直一直在等着哦！\n让我们来开始……最棒的对战吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_02
entries.text: 最后是这孩子啊……\n它必定会展现出最佳表现的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_03
entries.text: 闪耀发亮吧！\n我最棒的宝物！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_04
entries.text: 我们一起拿到的骨纹巨声鳄！\n我要让它展现出至今为止全部的成果！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_05
entries.text: 一开始告诉你的属性相克，\n现在竟然让我陷入了危机！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_06
entries.text: 这猛烈的一击怎么样？\n能使出全力真的太开心了！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_07
entries.text: 在最重要的关头击中要害！\n这已经不是运气，而是一种才能了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_mizu_08
entries.text: 这一次命中要害，\n是我绝对不想输的意志带来的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_01
entries.text: 就拜托你带来一场\n能娱乐观众的刺激对战咯～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_02
entries.text: 呃！这是有点小危机了！？\n大伙～！来来来快给我加油打气～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_03
entries.text: 出来吧，灵机一动的小灯泡～！\n就让我展示我奇树的潜能吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_04
entries.text: 要上咯，电击警报！\n若你被电到发麻，就不好意思咯！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_01
entries.text: 你真是很棒的素材，\n给你施怎样的魔法好呢？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_02
entries.text: 你还真是顽强啊，\n这可得好好卸妆啊。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_03
entries.text: 花洁夫人，要来幻妆咯！\n变成全新的自己吧！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_04
entries.text: 莉普的魔法幻妆，\n渗透至你毛孔的深处。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_01
entries.text: 双打对战是我莱姆的风格，\n轮番上阵超够格！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_02
entries.text: 被年轻力量逼到没退路！\n但是我还没有输！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_04
entries.text: 颤弦蝾螈灌注灵魂！\n这样观众才会举手欢腾！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_01
entries.text: 我已经阻止过你了哦，\n等下你输得一蹶不振我也不会管的。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_02
entries.text: 你确实并非浪得虚名，\n但只要踏错一步，就会掉进深渊哦。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_03
entries.text: 胜负和雪山很相似，\n两者都会在转眼间发生变化。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_04
entries.text: 绝望总是长伴在左右……\n在颤抖中入眠吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_01
entries.text: 所谓艺术，就是破坏与创造！\n你就全力挣扎，免得成为养分吧！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_02
entries.text: 挺有看头嘛！\n让我一口气将作品带领至完成吧！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_03
entries.text: 进一步精雕细琢！\n并将其命名为《出自谎言的真实》！！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_04
entries.text: 有时速度对艺术来说至关重要！\n我要提高速度了哦！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_01
entries.text: 尽管你对俺有恩，\n但俺是不会因此放水的！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_02
entries.text: 潮水乃会时涨时退！\n接下来就是惊涛骇浪的捕捞之时！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_03
entries.text: 是时候抛竿来个大变身了！\n水润美丽的出色宝可梦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_04
entries.text: 好好见识男子汉海岱的出招技巧吧！\n你可要捉紧别被冲走了！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_01
entries.text: 如果你小看虫宝可梦的话，\n可能就得吃苦头了哦～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_02
entries.text: 你干得挺不错嘛～\n接下来战况会向哪边倒呢～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_03
entries.text: 破蛹而出，\n强而有力地茁壮成长吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_04
entries.text: 闪耀的虫子装饰！\n也来品尝一下不甜的吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_01
entries.text: 就当是帮助饭后消化，\n让我适度地上吧。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_02
entries.text: 比起被上司责骂，\n现在的情况还不算什么。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_04
entries.text: 请问我使出社会人士\n所擅长的招式也没关系吧？[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_01
entries.text: 总算能够对战了！\n要是你一下子就输了，我可不会原谅你哦～！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_02
entries.text: 呼哈哈！很厉害嘛！\n你果然很有趣！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_03
entries.text: 看我把你干掉！\n土王！隆起吧！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_04
entries.text: 要小心站稳哦，\n因为稍微会有点摇晃！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_01
entries.text: 上吧，小大王！\n吼～的一声踩扁对手吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_02
entries.text: 最后一只宝可梦\n会帮波琵想办法的！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_03
entries.text: 小巨锻匠\n来打～扮打扮吧！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_04
entries.text: 硬邦邦的一边会赢！\n所以波琵会赢～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_01
entries.text: 这次我就用飞行属性\n承蒙你关照了。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_02
entries.text: 你的实力就如飙升的业绩，\n这将会是一场硬仗吗……[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_03
entries.text: 虽然这会弄乱头发，\n但我还是来改变风向吧。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_04
entries.text: 让我摆一下前辈的架子吧。\n请稍微注意。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_01
entries.text: 向小生使出你的真本事吧，\n小生会全力应对的。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_02
entries.text: 离合格还差一口气哦！\n加油！加油！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_03
entries.text: 将太晶宝石置于冠上！\n巨龙啊，降临吧！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_04
entries.text: 镇压所有东西的力量！\n预备～龙啊～！！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_01
entries.text: 请你一定要\n打赢我成为冠军。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_02
entries.text: 招式是要这样使出的，\n请好好感受一下站在顶点之人的实力吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_03
entries.text: 啊哈！啊哈哈哈哈！\n还不能放松下来哦！[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_04
entries.text: 不愧是你，判断很正确。\n请保持这样继续对战。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_05
entries.text: 怎么啦？你可不是会因\n这种程度的事情就焦急的人啊。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_06
entries.text: 真是致命一击，\n值得为此起立鼓掌啊。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_07
entries.text: 哦？真可怜……\n被击中要害了吗？[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_10
entries.text: 闪耀出引导训练家的\n光芒吧，晶光花。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_00_01
entries.text: 我想起讨厌的家伙了。\n……我得让你负上责任！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_01_02
entries.text: 我在寻找调味料之旅中\n遇上的宝可梦全明星！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_01_03
entries.text: 这是庆祝恢复活力的太晶化！\n闪耀吧，獒教父！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_01
entries.text: 竟然敢找天星队的茬，\n我看你真的是不要命的。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_02
entries.text: 手感ＯＫ！\n看我打飞你吧，入侵者！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_03
entries.text: ＤＪ恶事的频率！\n接收它然后坏掉吧！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_04
entries.text: 我的演出接下来才要\n开始提高ＢＰＭ！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_01
entries.text: 既然吾来到了，\n那坏蛋只有死路一条！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_02
entries.text: 也有些招式只要擦到皮肉\n就会导致中毒，很可怕的哦。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_03
entries.text: 在吾的妙招下\n逐渐被腐蚀掉吧！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_04
entries.text: 一不毒，二不休！\n秋明这条命会奉陪到底！！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_01
entries.text: 我会好好疼你的，\n你就泪流满面地滚回去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_02
entries.text: 你看清实力差距了吗？\n要投降就趁现在哦。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_03
entries.text: 吃我做作的一招！\n昏迷于我可爱的实力之下吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_04
entries.text: 哈啊！？这太没道理了吧！\n为什么是我被逼到没退路了？！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_01
entries.text: 这里是我们的地方，\n不要再捣乱了！！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_02
entries.text: 以牙还牙以眼还眼！！\n站到最后的人才是胜者！！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_04
entries.text: 我是……不会输的，\n所以……借我力量吧。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_01_02
entries.text: 刚才的……\n是被打败的手下们的份。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_01
entries.text: 我正是天星队的仙后！\n来，让大作战结束吧！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_02
entries.text: ……没办法了，\n请不要介意我使用太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_03
entries.text: 呵，我仙后\n居然会被压制住啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_04
entries.text: 以免会受伤，\n请你离远一点。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_hono_01
entries.text: 我正是天星队的仙后！\n来，让大作战结束吧！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_hono_02
entries.text: ……没办法了，\n请不要介意我使用太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text: 呵，我仙后\n居然会被压制住啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text: 以免会受伤，\n请你离远一点。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text: ……没办法了，\n请不要介意我使用太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text: 呵，我仙后\n居然会被压制住啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_mizu_04
entries.text: 以免会受伤，\n请你离远一点。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_01
entries.text: 要一决胜负就不能敷衍了事！\n这就是天星队规矩！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_02
entries.text: 宛如繁星般太晶化！\n变身成为理想的自己吧！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_03
entries.text: 你的实力强大无可挑剔，\n难怪老大们会被打败。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_04
entries.text: 让布布力量\n把你化为星尘吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_01
entries.text: 虽然不知道来者何人，\n但碍事者就让我驱逐出去吧。[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_02
entries.text: 这就是古代的力量，\n很厉害吧？[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_04
entries.text: 状况发展在我的预测之内。\n不好意思，你的胜算为零。[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_05
entries.text: 太让人感兴趣了……\n你知道古代宝可梦的弱点吗？[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_06
entries.text: 我的数据完美无缺，\n人类的脑袋能够抗衡吗？[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_07
entries.text: ……！发生问题！\n重新计算击中要害率……[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_08
entries.text: 如我计算一样击中要害，\n你快点死心吧。[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_01
entries.text: 虽然不知道来者何人，\n但碍事者就让我驱逐出去吧。[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_02
entries.text: 这就是未来的力量，\n很厉害吧？[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_04
entries.text: 状况发展在我的预测之内。\n不好意思，你的胜算为零。[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_05

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_07

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_08
entries.text: 如我计算一样击中要害，\n你快点死心吧。[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_01
entries.text: 无法使用球！\n这样可无法战斗啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_02
entries.text: 哇，被奇怪的电波干扰了！\n骇进系统也无法解除！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_03
entries.text: 好卑鄙……！这是\n大人该做的事吗！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_05a
entries.text: 你现在可是对战形态！\n加油，故勒顿！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_05b
entries.text: 你现在可是对战形态！\n加油，密勒顿！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_07
entries.text: 厉害，你顶住了！\n你一定能行……能行的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_08
entries.text: 什么！没能打倒！\n这样下去很糟糕啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_09
entries.text: 喂、喂，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的\n太晶珠是不是在发光啊！？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_01
entries.text: 这可是认真起来的奇树首度登场～！\n把眼睛睁得像小磁怪一样好好观赏吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你啊，\n就不能再给我一点面子吗？[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_03
entries.text: 出来吧，灵机一动的小灯泡～！\n胜利的发明哔哔哔～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_04
entries.text: 闪闪电电剪刀石头布！\n对电很弱的快过来～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_01
entries.text: 就让我以最高深的课程带你做入学体验，\n为你讲授莉普的美丽秘诀吧。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_02
entries.text: 这战况真是吓得人心慌慌，\n可会对明天的皮肤有影响啊。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_03
entries.text: 花洁夫人新陈代谢！\n转变为全新的你吧！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_04
entries.text: 首先要美丽！只要足够美丽，\n强大的实力就会随之而来哦。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_01
entries.text: 新生rookie，相当cutie！\n让我浑身颤抖吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_03
entries.text: 有光的地方就有影，\n赶快变身吧，好恨啊。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_04
entries.text: 妙语水平出类拔萃！\n让你看清你的误会！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_01
entries.text: 状态一般般，\n但要打赢你，这已经足够了。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_02
entries.text: 我不会容许得出冷场的结果，\n看我用零度的戏法玩弄你。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_03
entries.text: 雪啊！结晶啊！\n降下并积到我们身上吧！[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_04
entries.text: 让我用这个能夺取温度的招式\n来帮你冷静一下头脑吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_02
entries.text: 我现在的概念是植物的坚忍不拔！\n荆棘的刺可不是轻易能拔掉的哦！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_03
entries.text: 就让我回应期待吧！\n《出自谎言的真实 part2》！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_04
entries.text: 草啊……按我所想地\n生长吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_01
entries.text: 直接用心地品尝素材的味道吧，\n这就是真正的海岱！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_02
entries.text: 背水一战呀，啊、哈、哈！\n这可是宝可梦对战的趣味所在！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_03
entries.text: 好胜毛蟹太晶化吧！\n不要拘泥于形状，流淌吧！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_04
entries.text: 尽全力吸气吧！\n激流马上就要来咯！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_01
entries.text: 今天我要用上苦涩的味道哦～！\n你要是输了也不要哭哦～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_02
entries.text: 虫属性就是要有忍耐力！\n朝着胜利扑过去～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_03
entries.text: 小熊熊～！让我看看\n你羽化后的样子吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_04
entries.text: 看我用点缀过的招式碾压你！\n这样的甜点你喜欢吗～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_01
entries.text: 你也不容易啊，\n因为首席可是个很有个性的人。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_02
entries.text: 你实力蛮强的嘛，\n那就让我顽强抵抗一下。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_03
entries.text: 来展露自我吧，\n就像平时一样，拜托你了。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_04
entries.text: 请问威力怎么样？\n麻烦你确认一下。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_01
entries.text: 我希望能和你平起平坐……\n所以我会充满野心地上！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_02
entries.text: 一点不剩地尝尝\n我真正的实力吧……！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_03
entries.text: 发出激斗校园大战中\n最闪亮的光芒吧，獒教父！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_04
entries.text: 用经过锻炼的下颚狠狠啃咬！\n将那家伙的胜利粉碎吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_01
entries.text: 展现个性，自由自在地\n把你的能力发挥出来吧。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_02
entries.text: 哇，你真强啊！\n是在培育方法上有什么秘诀吗？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_03
entries.text: 让我来注入力量。\n也就是太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_04
entries.text: 我改变一下出招的模式吧。\n这会带来怎样的结果呢？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_01
entries.text: 堂堂正正决一胜负！\n祝你有理想的表现！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_02
entries.text: 不错嘛！转学生！\n我的斗志顿时都涌出来了！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_03
entries.text: 超越昨天的自我！\n向着明天嘿呀！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_04
entries.text: 一定要使出全力！\n这样取得的胜利才有意义！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_01
entries.text: 由我和你两人的力量\n来引导大家吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_02
entries.text: 让我们来一场足以称之为\n最终一战的最棒的对决吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_03
entries.text: 像帕底亚的未来般\n闪耀吧，晶光花。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_04
entries.text: 实力强大是理所当然的……而想要\n称得上为冠军，还需要魅力过人哦！[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_01
entries.text: 被逼至悬崖边上才是我们\n发挥真正实力的时候哦！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_02
entries.text: 獒教父太晶化吧！\n你才是最闪耀的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_03
entries.text: 就是那！上吧～！\n让他们见识一下你强大的力量！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_02_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你真是什么时候都\n全力以赴啊……不，我是在称赞你。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_02_02
entries.text: 如星辰般光辉，太晶化！\n变身成为理想的自己吧！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_02_03
entries.text: 要上咯，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。\n看我用这招弄得你布布叫！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_01
entries.text: 我是不会轻易将胜利让出的！\n让我重整旗鼓！！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_02
entries.text: 超越明天的自己！\n朝着夕阳，太晶化！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_03
entries.text: 我要以全力向你碰撞！\n热血飓风！！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_taimu_01_01
entries.text: ６－５＝剩余１只！\n但它能发挥１０倍的实力所以能顶１０只。[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_taimu_01_02
entries.text: 盐石巨灵\n稍微再强硬一点吧。[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_taimu_01_03

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rehoru_01_01
entries.text: 局势在最后关头往往会被逆转……\n你也要试试重现那样的历史吗？[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rehoru_01_02
entries.text: 看我使用巨坑的技术。\n启动吧，科技～！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rehoru_01_03
entries.text: 来测试一下你和宝可梦\n有着怎样的历史吧。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_mimoza_01_01
entries.text: 不要，天哪，骗人的吧～！\n就剩下１只了呀～！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_mimoza_01_02
entries.text: 开始吧，超坏星！\n这是你的舞台。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_mimoza_01_03
entries.text: 给你送上一招厉害的！\n等下我会拿出药给你哦！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sawaro_01_01
entries.text: 冷静应对！\n萨瓦罗啊，现在正是要咬紧牙关的时候。[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sawaro_01_02
entries.text: 要可爱地上咯。\n布莉姆温，太晶化吧。[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sawaro_01_03
entries.text: 就算是学生我也不会手下留情的，\n更不要说你是冠军。[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_02_01
entries.text: 你果然很强啊！\n真想你教教我培育方法。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_02_02
entries.text: 太晶化准备就绪！\n太晶珠启动。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_02_03
entries.text: 这一招怎么样？\n我想应该会稍微有点效果。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_seizi_01_01
entries.text: 要在这里说拜拜的未必是\n我赛吉……而可能是You哦！！[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_seizi_01_02
entries.text: You想看看赛吉\n有点厉害的一面吧？[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_seizi_01_03
entries.text: 招式也是一种交流！\n来接下我们的问候吧！[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_08_kusa_01
entries.text: 很厉害嘛！[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n最后就让我用这孩子夺得胜利吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_08_kusa_02
entries.text: 就是现在，太晶化！\n闪耀起来发起进攻！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: 我要拿出全力咯！\n你准备好了吗？我的劲敌！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_01
entries.text: 决赛也到尾声了！\n来划下完美的句号吧！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_02
entries.text: 只有顶点才配得上龙！\n让一切染上你的颜色吧！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_03
entries.text: 龙属性进一步龙！\n这乃龙中之龙！！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_01
entries.text: 你有在不懈地钻研啊，\n真是帕底亚冠军的榜样。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_02
entries.text: 化为照耀顶点的光吧，\n晶光花。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_03
entries.text: 首席冠军的气魄！！\n请你超越过去吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_01_01
entries.text: 对战开始精彩起来了！\n我要把朋友叫来一起声援～！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_02_01
entries.text: 那孩子好像果然很厉害！\n保持这个样子加油吧！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_02_02
entries.text: 啊啊～抵挡住了！\n这惊险万分的攻防真让人上瘾啊！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_01
entries.text: 真是使出了不得了的一招啊！\n我都着迷得要成为粉丝了！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_02
entries.text: 那孩子的话，\n我相信接下来肯定会做些什么的！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_03
entries.text: 漂亮的招式选择！\n给了ＭＣ卡玛有力的一击！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_05
entries.text: 莱姆还有那位同学！\n期待你们会带来一场狂热的对战哦！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_06
entries.text: 莱姆的宝可梦被击倒了！？\n唔哦～！我兴奋起来了！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_07
entries.text: 莱姆的攻击被抵挡住了！\n加油，加油～！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_08
entries.text: 一脸若无其事地挖出对手弱点！\n真够SWAG嘛！！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_09
entries.text: 居然在这时太晶化！\n时机真是巧妙！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_10
entries.text: 气氛真是热烈！来举高双手！\n莱姆！莱姆！莱姆！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_11
entries.text: 答案不用问都知道，还击吧！\n莱姆！莱姆！莱姆！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_12
entries.text: 效果绝佳超犀利的！\n莱姆！莱姆！莱姆！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_13
entries.text: 幽灵太晶化最棒了～！\n莱姆你真的超级闪亮哦！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_01
entries.text: １天１次的限定演出！\n欢迎来到ＤＪ恶事的舞台。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_03
entries.text: 我要大肆使坏啦！\n毕竟要是手下留情，也成不了特训！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_04
entries.text: 你会跟我一起演出的吧？\n我可不会让你抢走观众的！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_01
entries.text: 见识一下吾日夜在学校\n修行所得到的实力吧！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_03
entries.text: 亲身感受吾的\n毒之精髓吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_04
entries.text: 猛毒即使只有一滴也是威胁！\n现在放松还为时尚早哦！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_01
entries.text: 这次赢的会是我！\n你就继续掉以轻心吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_03
entries.text: 我要使出可爱到作弊的招式咯！\n卷起身体感受痛苦吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_04
entries.text: 哈啊～！？我都快输了呀！？\n你的实力已经算是作弊了吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_02_03
entries.text: 既然要一战，那就让我\n竭尽全力……打倒你！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_02_04
entries.text: 被逼至绝境更要集中精神！\n仍然有胜利的希望！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_02_01
entries.text: 你真是个怪人啊。\n……没，不要在意。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_02_04
entries.text: 火烧眼眉了。\n你的确很厉害嘛。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_01
entries.text: 欢迎来到北上。\n先细细品味泥土的味道吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_02
entries.text: 哼……没想到，\n你还知道属性相克啊。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_03
entries.text: 噫～！这算什么！\n你是瞎蒙的吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_04
entries.text: 你不知道属性相克吗？\n大概是预习得不够充分吧～？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_05
entries.text: 北上的洗礼感觉如何？\n虽然我也挺过意不去的。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_06
entries.text: 斯魔茶！\n用超级吸取让[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她尝尝厉害！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_07
entries.text: 斯魔茶！\n用暗影球让[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她尝尝厉害！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_01
entries.text: 哇～好像在做梦一样……！\n能跟你对战……好开心！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_02
entries.text: 噫嘿嘿……弱点\n被狠狠针对了。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_03
entries.text: 竟然能击中这种地方！？\n运气也是实力……呜咕咕咕。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_04
entries.text: 难、难道说你放水了？\n我……不太喜欢这样哦。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_05
entries.text: 加了个油，蜻蜻蜓！\n把……把风劈开吧！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_06
entries.text: 加了个油，蜻蜻蜓！\n振……振动羽翼吧！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_01
entries.text: 这、这次一定要\n打出漂亮的对战……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_02
entries.text: 好厉害的一击！\n伤害竟然这么高！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_03
entries.text: 刚才的攻击\n害得我整个人都缩了一下。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_04
entries.text: 大尾立，上咧！\n嗖的一下冲上去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_05
entries.text: 蚊香君，上咧！\n用整个身体撞上去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_01
entries.text: 你就拜倒在我的轻便和服下好了。\n我会趁机打倒你的。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_02
entries.text: 等等！你还记恨着面具那事儿！？\n别再来效果绝佳了！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_03
entries.text: 击中要害有什么大不了的？\n我可一点都没慌哦。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_04
entries.text: 我会把你打个落花流水，\n然后痛痛快快地去逛庆典！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_05
entries.text: 今天是个值得庆祝的日子，\n所以要来点尽兴的哦！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_06
entries.text: 今天是个值得庆祝的日子，\n所以要来点尽兴的哦！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_01
entries.text: 我、我想赢！\n所以……加了个油！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_02
entries.text: 啊啊，弄错了！\n不应该是这样的……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_03
entries.text: 怎么会！？\n局势会被对手掌控的！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_04
entries.text: 为什么会这样？\n为什么……为什么？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_05
entries.text: 裹蜜虫，加了个油！\n让对手裹满糖浆吧！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_06
entries.text: 裹蜜虫，加了个油！\n让对手裹满糖浆吧！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_midoriikenushi_01_01_01
entries.text: 这家伙看起来很强！\n有我一起，算你走运～[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_midoriikenushi_01_01_02
entries.text: 它变弱了！\n一口气解决战斗吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_01
entries.text: 我知道这对不住你，\n但我不能退让。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_02
entries.text: 我还能挽回！\n加了个油……加了个油！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_03
entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你拥有一切，\n就像故事的主人公啊。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_04
entries.text: 刚才这招很管用吧？\n我能战胜[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你……我要赢！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_05
entries.text: 太棒了！\n我要继续掌控局势！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_06
entries.text: 我会好好做出……\n正确的指示！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_07
entries.text: 我会好好做出……\n正确的指示！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_02
entries.text: 时髦的围巾让人火大！\n看我让你难堪地坐下！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_03
entries.text: 一锤定音的是我！\n你要让给我这个队长哦！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_04
entries.text: 哦～原来弱点在那里啊！\n分析得漂亮，副队长！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_05
entries.text: 你还挺会击中要害呢！\n但队长的宝座，我可不会让哦！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_02
entries.text: 如果让它出洋相，\n那张脸也会变得红红～的吗？

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_03
entries.text: 漂亮的招式！\n上啊！干掉它～！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_04
entries.text: 嘻嘻，找～到弱点了！\n我要一招鲜到打赢为止。

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_05
entries.text: 嘻嘻，很有效哦！\n击中奇怪的地方啦～？

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_02
entries.text: 虽说是对手，脸却很漂亮。\n总觉得和我有点像？

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_03
entries.text: 悠着点！我这边还要\n给它大量的伤害呢！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_04
entries.text: 行啊！不愧是我的跟班……\n我是说朋友！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_05
entries.text: 谁让你对厄诡椪那么坏，\n这下遭报应了吧！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_02
entries.text: 很高兴你能拿出真本事。\n我也会使出全力的！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_03
entries.text: 就算运气不站在我这边，\n我也要加了个油……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_04
entries.text: 我还没输！\n再也……不想输了！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_05
entries.text: 对手再强我也要正面迎战！\n用必中的这招！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_06
entries.text: 对手再强我也要正面迎战！\n用双翼打过去吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_02
entries.text: 你克制了对手的属性啊！\n不愧是我看好的人！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_04
entries.text: 现在还不能捕捉！\n再拿出点实力给它看看！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_05
entries.text: 它好像终于用光力气了！\n要捕捉厄诡椪的话，就是现在！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_06
entries.text: 它把面具太晶化了！\n原来这才是厄诡椪真正的力量！？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_01
entries.text: 既然你害我早早起床，\n就得让我玩得尽兴才行哦。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_02
entries.text: 你怎么总戳别人的痛处！\n我猜你朋友很少吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_03
entries.text: 要害在哪儿啊？\n绝对没击中！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_04
entries.text: 你以后就算想跟我走，\n我也不会管你了哦！厄诡椪！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_05
entries.text: 你就傻乎乎地看着吧！\n我会把你刷、来、刷、去！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_06
entries.text: 你就傻乎乎地看着吧！\n我会把你刷、来、刷、去！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_01
entries.text: 摆个好看的表情吧。\n看我拍下精彩瞬间。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_02
entries.text: 同学，你很厉害嘛！\n我都没法专心拍照了。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_03
entries.text: 好痛好痛……\n吓得我相机都差点掉了！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_04
entries.text: 这孩子怎么样？\n它应该会有点难对付哦。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_05
entries.text: 要上咯，叶伊布！\n看我拍下精彩瞬间！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_06
entries.text: 要上咯，叶伊布！\n看我拍下精彩瞬间！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_ariados_01_01_02
entries.text: 哦？按下快门的好机会！\n可是我站不起来！好不甘心～！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_ariados_01_01_03
entries.text: 战况渐入佳境！？\n拜托了，替我拍几张照片吧～！！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_02
entries.text: 这种临场感，好棒好棒！！\n继续，继续……！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_03
entries.text: 又要摆出不同的表情了！\n很好，太有拍照的价值啦。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_04
entries.text: 赫月变弱了！\n捕捉的机会来了，助手！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_01
entries.text: 和[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你共同冒险的回忆\n将成为厄诡椪的力量！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_02
entries.text: 大家一起夺回面具的回忆\n将成为厄诡椪的力量！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_03
entries.text: 和很久以前一起生活的男人的回忆\n将成为厄诡椪的力量！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_01
entries.text: 作为蓝莓学园的代表，\n我可不能给学园丢脸呀。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_02
entries.text: 原来如此！你精准地发动了\n属性相克的进攻啊。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_03
entries.text: 被击中痛处了，\n该如何重整旗鼓……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_04
entries.text: 正负电战术失败了……\n那么，我就硬上了哦。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_05
entries.text: 龙头地鼠！拜托了～！\n用尽全力摇晃吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_01
entries.text: 机会难得，我要让你尝尝\n生态巨蛋的泥土的味道！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_02
entries.text: 喂！你偶尔也用一下\n效果不好的招式嘛！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_03
entries.text: 你怎么就～知道打那种地方！\n我来教教你什么是温柔吧？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_04
entries.text: 差不多该动真格地用那～个了！\n嘻嘻……要不要太晶一下呢～？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_05
entries.text: 上吧，来悲粗茶！\n刷翻全场吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_06
entries.text: 啊，这不是厄诡椪嘛！\n你果然是想我了？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_01
entries.text: 那么，烹饪……\n不对！对战开始！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_02
entries.text: 啥～！？吃了这样的招式\n火都要熄灭了～！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_03
entries.text: 咦？我受到了\n巨～大的伤害！？为啥啊！？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_04
entries.text: 大火熊熊太晶化！\n赤红冉冉火焰鸡～！！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_05
entries.text: 这就是我的招牌料理！\n大口吃赤松套餐吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_01
entries.text: 盔甲鸟、三地鼠，各就各位。\n准时结束这场战斗吧。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_02
entries.text: 已确认属性被克制……！\n我被趁虚而入，眼镜变得雾蒙蒙的。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_03
entries.text: 难免也有这种运气差的时候啊。\n我学到了很多，谢谢你。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_04
entries.text: ……时间越拖越晚，\n是时候一分高下了。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_05
entries.text: 你的体力越多，\n中了这招就会越痛苦。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_01
entries.text: 这次我是以四天王的身份，\n拿平时常用的同行宝可梦和你对战哦。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_02
entries.text: 攻击弱点是惯用手法没错……\n但我也会以牙还牙哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_03
entries.text: 你击中奇怪的地方了！\n我觉得这样不好哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_04
entries.text: 注意看我的太晶之心！\n变得更～可爱吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_05
entries.text: 龙头地鼠，上吧～！\n爆发吧，可爱的破坏力！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_01
entries.text: 给我好～好地打赢哦。\n期待落空的话，我会哭的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_02
entries.text: 哦～！？你竟然打出效果绝佳！\n我们的弱点明明很少啊！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_03
entries.text: 啊～！真是欲罢不能！\n你居然连运气都能掌控啊！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_04
entries.text: 沸腾吧，龙之血，\n主宰一切吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_05
entries.text: 我要彻底释放！\n你想往哪儿逃都没用哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_01
entries.text: 我没有错……\n现在就证明给你看！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_02
entries.text: 我锻炼过的招式怎么样？\n和在北上的时候不一样吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_03
entries.text: 可恶！哇呀……\n就算属性被克制，我也不会输！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_04
entries.text: 连运气都站在你那边，这不公平……\n不公平！不公平！不公平！！不公平！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_05
entries.text: 我不需要过去的自己！\n所以我改变了……我要改变！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_06
entries.text: 怎么还不倒下啊？\n我已经使出浑身解数了！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_07
entries.text: 我也想亲手……\n将胜利收入囊中！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_08
entries.text: 你竟然……现在！在这里！！\n派出了鬼！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_01
entries.text: 上吧！太乐巴戈斯！\n让[VAR 0x0100(0000)]见识一下你的力量！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_02
entries.text: 什么，它竟然有弱点？\n它可是……零之秘宝啊！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_03
entries.text: 这种时候都能击中要害？\n你的主角光环也太厉害咧……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_04
entries.text: 秘宝应该很厉害才对吧！？\n快解放真正的力量吧！快！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_05
entries.text: 这就是零之秘宝真正的样子吗！？\n如果是这样……我能赢……！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_06
entries.text: 太乐巴戈斯的力量应该不止如此……\n有什么条件不够吗……？[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_02
entries.text: 能量失控了！？\n这样下去很危险！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_03
entries.text: 大伙儿，抱歉！\n拜托你们让太乐巴戈斯……停下来！！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01
entries.text: 喂！阿栗你也快点！\n得想办法搞定太乐巴戈斯才行……！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_01
entries.text: 不、不该是这样……不对……\n都是因为我……才变成这样吗……！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_02
entries.text: 这是减轻伤害的屏障吗……！？\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]太晶化[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]也许会有效！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_03
entries.text: 大伙儿，趁现在！\n用太晶化来反击！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_04
entries.text: 来悲粗茶被打倒了……\n怎么回事……它强过头了吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_06
entries.text: 抱歉！我的宝可梦\n全都被打倒了！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_07
entries.text: 那么厉害的屏障，又来了一个！？\n是吸收能量后再次展开的吗？[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_07_01
entries.text: 阿栗！你也上啊！\n现在全是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]一个人在打！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_08
entries.text: 就是现在，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n你又能用太晶化让宝可梦闪耀了！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09_01
entries.text: 它又吸收能量了！？\n虽然这不可能无限持续下去……[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09
entries.text: 阿栗！[VAR 0x0100(0000)]遇到麻烦了！\n喂！我说你啊！也给我拿出干劲来！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09_02
entries.text: 可、可是……不行……\n我、我……我这种人……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_10_01
entries.text: 真是的……真的！太慢了！\n你们两个给我想办法摆平一切！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_11
entries.text: 看样子它无法吸收能量或者\n再次展开屏障了！好机会！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_14
entries.text: 交给[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你的话，我很放心。\n……加了个油！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_man_02_01_02
entries.text: 哇、哇呀，太突然了！\n为什么要袭击过来……！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_man_02_01_03
entries.text: 抱歉，只能用对战\n让你们冷静下来咧……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_old_02_01_02
entries.text: 爷爷！奶奶！连你们都！\n怎……怎么回事啊！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_old_02_01_03
entries.text: 为什么会变成这样……\n咕呜……只能上咧……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_02
entries.text: 咭呗咭呗～！！\n啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_03
entries.text: 这……厉害……\n咭呗咭呗，咭呗咭呗～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_04
entries.text: 不愧……戳到……痛处……\n咭呗咭呗，咭呗咭呗～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_05
entries.text: 还没……完……对战……\n咭呗咭呗，咭呗咭呗，咭呗咭呗～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_kusa_02
entries.text: 咭呗咭呗～！！\n啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_botan_02_01_04
entries.text: 嗯嘎啊啊啊啊嘶！！\n唧咿啊呗……啾啊吧咿～！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dokutaro_02_01_02
entries.text: 有、有效果……也就是说，\n那家伙能被打倒！加了个油！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dokutaro_02_01_04
entries.text: 那家伙动作变迟缓了！\n就是现在！把它封进球里！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_01
entries.text: 观看人数就像麻麻鳗鱼王跳龙门！\n嘻嘻……太激动人心了～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_02
entries.text: 出来吧，闪闪的小灯泡～！\n漂浮的电属性是无～敌～的！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_03
entries.text: 闪闪电电剪刀石头布！\n好刺激，好开心，指哪儿，看哪儿！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_01
entries.text: 被逼入逆境时，\n莉普我才愈发美丽。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_02
entries.text: 超级充满魔力的幻妆！\n不准看别处！１秒都不行！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_03
entries.text: 咦？你的盆骨是不是歪了？\n让我用强念给你矫正一下。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_01
entries.text: 体力不支，陷入危机，\n巧妙反击，让你归西！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_02
entries.text: 莫要心烦，颤弦蝾螈！\n冷汗走开，放声来嗨！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_03
entries.text: 大病初愈很忧郁？\n祸不单行如受刑！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_01
entries.text: 随便输掉也太尴冷了，\n我会再……挣扎一下的。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_02
entries.text: 雪静静地降下并堆积，\n仿佛覆盖并隐藏脆弱一般。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_03
entries.text: 冷冰冰的招式，要上咯。\n我才不管你会不会冻僵。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_01
entries.text: 不错哦，堪称前卫艺术！\n保持这个劲头继续创作吧！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_02
entries.text: 永远充满话题性才是名作！\n《出自谎言的真实 forever》！！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_03
entries.text: 要加快速度了！\n阁下的话，应该能跟上吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_01
entries.text: 对战如水！啊、哈、哈！\n充满变数才对头！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_02
entries.text: 上吧，是时候抛竿来个大变身了！\n要变得鲜活又水润哦～！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_03
entries.text: 水滴石穿！\n想见识一下这种威力吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_01
entries.text: 虫属性忍耐力超强～！\n看我从脚下掀翻你～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_02
entries.text: 小熊熊，装饰起来！\n戴上触角扮虫虫～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_03
entries.text: 不快点阻止这个招式，\n会发生了不得的事情哦～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_01
entries.text: 在工作时间内的话，\n我会对应到最后。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_02
entries.text: 普通就很好，\n来点一般的吧。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_03
entries.text: 社会人士所擅长的招式！\n……说出来会让人难过啊。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_01
entries.text: 被你压着打我也不慌！\n我重要的搭档还没上场呢！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_02
entries.text: 獒教父，知道该干什么吧？\n你要当最闪耀的那个！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_03
entries.text: 用结实的后槽牙狠狠咬碎！\n每天的牙可不是白刷的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_01
entries.text: 哎呀～糟糕，\n不得不派出最后的布布了～[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_02
entries.text: 星辰啊，绽放光辉，太晶化！\n变成理想的自己吧！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_03
entries.text: 星光啊，照射吧！\n用布布力量大闹一场！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_01
entries.text: 不到最后绝不放弃的精神！\n注入士气，嘿呀！嘿呀！！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_02
entries.text: 紧握的拳头化为力量！\n用沸腾的血液太晶化！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_03
entries.text: 上吧！进攻！攻击身体！\n舍弃防守，全力进攻！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_01
entries.text: 不归零就不算输。\n我该石石在在地马力全开了吧？[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_02
entries.text: 岩石属性　×　岩石太晶，\n棱角要变成几倍呢？[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_03
entries.text: 盐石巨灵，上吧！\n用锐角进行尖石攻击！[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_01
entries.text: 历史是由背叛连锁而成。\n得志之时更要戒骄戒躁。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_02
entries.text: 虽然用最新技术不符合我的性格，\n但是启动吧，科技！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_03
entries.text: 沉浸在怨念之中吧。\n降低你的特防我就赚到了。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_01
entries.text: 不要，感觉快输了！\n超～级不像话～！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_02
entries.text: 超坏星，你太棒了！\n这是你的舞台。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_03
entries.text: 给你送上一招了不得的！\n俗话说，是药三分毒哦！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_01
entries.text: 赌上这身肌肉顽强抵抗！\n萨瓦罗啊，现在正是要咬紧牙关的时候。[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_02
entries.text: 论可爱也不会输。\n布莉姆温，太晶化吧。[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_03
entries.text: 要不要被\n吸取精气的接吻所俘获呢？[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_01
entries.text: 真不愧是你～好开心～\n虽然我被逼到没退路了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_02
entries.text: 输出确认无误！\n启动太晶珠～！[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_03
entries.text: 奇麒麟，要上咯～！\n用念动嘿呀地发起进攻～！[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_seizi_01_01
entries.text: 赛吉我很伤脑筋啊～！\n宝可梦！竟然！Only one！[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_seizi_01_02

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_01
entries.text: 你竟然变得这么强……\n我不能就这样结束对战。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_02
entries.text: 校长我也要来真的。\n用太晶化绽放光芒吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_03
entries.text: 那么，骨纹巨声鳄，\n使出暗影球如何？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_mizu_01
entries.text: 你竟然变得这么强……\n我不能就这样结束对战。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_mizu_02
entries.text: 校长我也要来真的。\n用太晶化绽放光芒吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_mizu_03
entries.text: 那么，魔幻假面喵，\n使出千变万花如何？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_hono_01
entries.text: 你竟然变得这么强……\n我不能就这样结束对战。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_hono_02
entries.text: 校长我也要来真的。\n用太晶化绽放光芒吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_hono_03
entries.text: 那么，狂欢浪舞鸭，\n使出劈瓦如何？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_01
entries.text: 凡事的关键都是收尾阶段。\n我来画龙点睛吧。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_02
entries.text: 是时候戴上龙之桂冠了。\n把周围染成你的颜色吧！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_03
entries.text: 从背后失敬了！\n戟脊龙，巨剑突击！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_01
entries.text: 啊哈！啊哈哈哈哈！\n我还没被逼到绝路哦！[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_02
entries.text: 照亮巅峰，\n闪耀吧，仆刀将军。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_03
entries.text: 光芒啊，\n从万丈高处席卷一切吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_01
entries.text: 你果然很厉害啊～\n我使出全力也打不坏你。[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_02
entries.text: 要我再疼爱你一下吗？\n土王！隆起吧！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_03
entries.text: 今天要做好心理准备哦。\n因为我会放开了摇晃的。[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_01
entries.text: 我还没输呢！\n我会“找回肠子”的～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_02
entries.text: 小巨锻匠，\n要好好打扮，变得硬邦邦的～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_03
entries.text: 给你来点硬的。\n请尝尝我的厉害吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_01
entries.text: 同行还剩……呃！\n下一只是最后的宝可梦了！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_02
entries.text: 明火熊熊太晶化！\n热气腾腾火焰鸡～！！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_03
entries.text: 吞下我辛～辣的招式吧！\n还有一手能让你输得咸咸的呢！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_hagane4_01_01
entries.text: 局势不利……\n但纳莉我斗志不减。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_hagane4_01_03
entries.text: 开始加压。\n要恨就恨自己体力不够吧。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_01
entries.text: 我不怕你占上风！\n我会硬拼不会输！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_02
entries.text: 看我的太晶之心～！\n给你分点可爱吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_03
entries.text: 龙头地鼠，上吧～！\n用可爱的招式迷倒对手！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_01
entries.text: 火辣辣地痛啊，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们！\n对战就得这样！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_02
entries.text: 沸腾吧，龙之血，\n告诉[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她谁是主宰者～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_03
entries.text: 我要通通释放出来！\n停止沸腾之前不许你走哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_01
entries.text: 说～逼就逼上来！\n你也就现在能装装从容了！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_02
entries.text: 别想一个人出风头！\n我也会让宝可梦太晶的！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_03
entries.text: 你想被刷来刷去？\n嘻嘻，别客气！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_01
entries.text: 好难受……但很快乐！\n我要从这里重新开始！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_02
entries.text: 我要把永远不变的心情！\n现在！都汇入太晶化里！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_03
entries.text: 拼尽全力加了个油！\n蜜集大蛇也跟我来！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_01
entries.text: 你很有两下子嘛～\n总觉得越来越有趣了！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_02
entries.text: 难得来了这么多观众，\n让我来做点有趣的事情！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_03
entries.text: 这招怎么样～？\n有能耐就抗下来吧。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kirafuroru_02_01_01
entries.text: 那个能量是怎么回事！？\n难道……那就是……！？[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
